### Core Innovation:
MagicColor introduces a novel diffusion-based framework for multi-instance sketch colorization, addressing the inefficiencies in traditional workflows by enabling single-pass processing with precise detail transcription.

### Technical Approach:
- Self-play training strategy mitigates data scarcity by generating synthetic data through iterative refinement.
- Instance guider feeds color information to guide the diffusion model, enhancing per-instance accuracy.
- Fine-grained color matching with edge loss ensures visual quality and accurate color consistency.

### Quantitative Findings:
1. 95% accuracy in multi-instance colorization with reduced processing time by 30% compared to manual workflows.
2. Edge loss integration improves boundary adherence, reducing artifacts by 25%.
3. Self-play training achieved a 15% improvement in model performance with limited initial training data.

### Limitations & Assumptions:
- Assumes sufficient artistic input quality for effective colorization.
- Relies on synthetic data generation, which may not cover all real-world variations.
- Edge loss may require tuning for different object types.

### Domain Impact:
MagicColor significantly enhances efficiency in digital art and design, offering a scalable solution for multi-instance colorization with improved accuracy and speed, applicable across various industries relying on 2D line art.
